The *Pītittika* (Patthana 19.7) is a canonical Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh treatise of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Within the structural arrangements of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the text treats causal conditional relations associated with the *pīti-ttika* (the triad pertaining to rapture) [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral does not record an English translation title for this specific leaf section [SuttaCentral].
